input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation or most-favoured-customer obligation on us. Section 12.3 expressly confirms that we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and the pricing provisions (§ 7.1 fixed Fees; § 8.3 capped renewal uplift) run in our favour against Vendor rather than obliging us to extend Vendor any better terms given to third parties. Searches for MFN, "no less favourable", best-pricing and third-party-matching language returned nothing. This meets the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
